tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (16.1:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: sotheby-s-blue
tokens.usage: Authority, trust, institutional prestige. Used as background on `header`, `.stat-card::before`, `.lot-image::after`; shadow/glow on `header`, `.stat-card:hover`, `.lot-card:hover`; text on `.house-crest`, `.specialist-access`, `.specialist-access:hover`. 10.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Museum-quality presentation, refined sophistication. Used as background on `body`, `tbody tr:hover`; text on `header`, `nav a`, `.place-bid-btn`; border on `.house-crest`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Luxury, investment value, precious objects. Used as border on `header`, `.specialist-access`, `.lot-provenance`; background on `.house-crest`, `.specialist-access`, `.stat-card::before`; shadow/glow on `.house-crest`, `.specialist-access:hover`. 2.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Timeless elegance, printed catalog aesthetic. Used as text on `body`, `.lot-title`, `.table-title`; background on `footer`. 16.1:1 on `page-bg`.
